description: This Java class defines a final class `CompressedSubscriptions` for managing local subscription data based on compressed hash codes. It extends `AbstractSubscriptions` and implements `Hashes`, providing functionality for handling subscription topics as hash sequences, including methods for adding/removing topics, exporting updates, and managing hash seeds.

classes.name: CompressedSubscriptions
classes.description: A final class managing compressed subscription data with hash code sequences and update management, ensuring thread safety with the `@NotThreadSafe` annotation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of `CompressedSubscriptions` with the specified hash function seeds, initialized with empty maps and an empty update set.

methods.name: hashTopic
methods.description: Converts a topic string into a ByteString of hash codes using the `CompressedDDataHandler`.

methods.name: onNewTopic
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new topic, updating the hash code to topic count map and inserting new hashes into updates if needed.

methods.name: onRemovedTopic
methods.description: Handles the removal of a topic, updating the count and deleting hashes from updates when count reaches zero.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the collection of hash function seeds used for hashing topics.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the current update state, either forcing an all-replace update or exporting and resetting recent updates.
